readings.title: The box with a closing time
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A small farm offered weekly produce boxes but accepted changes until the delivery van left. Packing was repeatedly interrupted, and labels sometimes no longer matched the contents. The farm introduced a clear order deadline the previous evening. Customers could still contact the office about urgent problems, but ordinary changes moved to the next delivery. Packing became more orderly. The deadline was explained as a way to prepare accurately, rather than as a penalty for customers who changed their minds.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: Three streets, one collection point
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A neighbourhood delivery scheme stopped at every house, even when several customers lived around the same small square. With residents' agreement, the organiser tried a shared collection point for one afternoon a week. Customers who could not reach it retained doorstep delivery. The driver made fewer repeated turns, and most boxes were collected within an hour. The organiser counted uncollected boxes as well as travel time, recognising that an efficient route was not useful if customers could not receive their orders.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: The crate's second journey
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A vegetable cooperative bought strong reusable crates and expected packaging purchases to fall. In the first month, however, many crates remained in customers' homes. A reminder alone did little because people were unsure where to leave them. The cooperative added a return instruction to delivery confirmations and collected empties with the next order. More crates came back into circulation. Buying a reusable object was only the start; its repeated use depended on a convenient return journey.

readings.title: The price beside the weight
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: At a market stall, one bag of apples cost less than another, but the bags contained different weights. A customer asked which offered better value. The seller added a price per kilogram beside each bag price and explained that the varieties also differed. Customers could now compare quantities while still choosing by taste or intended use. The extra number did not decide the purchase for them; it made one part of the comparison clearer.

translation.stem:
Translate this original passage into natural Chinese, preserving its meaning and logical connections.

A local delivery service connects many small decisions. An order affects packing, a packing label guides the driver, and a return instruction helps a container be used again. When one link is unclear, work may be repeated elsewhere. Improving the service often begins by making these connections visible to both workers and customers.
translation.referenceAnswer: 本地配送服务把许多小决定连接起来。订单影响打包，包装标签指引司机，归还说明帮助容器再次使用。当其中一个环节不清楚时，别处的工作就可能重复。改进服务往往始于让工作人员和客户都看清这些联系。
translation.explanation: 参考译文不是唯一答案；信息完整、逻辑准确且中文自然的其他译法同样有效。

writing.stem:
Write about 120 words in English for this original simulation task.

Write a customer notice for a fictional vegetable-box service introducing a reusable-crate return arrangement. Explain when and where to return crates, what to do if the usual arrangement is unsuitable, and why returns matter.
writing.sampleAnswer: From next month, our vegetable boxes will arrive in reusable crates. Please empty your crate and leave it at the sheltered collection point named in your delivery confirmation before your next order arrives. The driver will collect it while delivering your new box. If you will be away or cannot use that collection point, contact the office so that we can agree on another arrangement. Please do not leave crates where they block a doorway or public path. Returning them promptly lets us use the same containers for many journeys and reduces the need to buy new packaging. We will send a reminder with each order, and your comments will help us make the return process convenient. Thank you for taking part.
writing.explanation: 范文展示一种可行的回应；允许不同观点和例子，按任务完成、组织和语言评分。
